plans.goal: Stand ground at camp center using log and fire as cover, trip charging wolves, coordinate kill
steps: Hold the log perimeter with Borin
Let wolves charge into kill zone
Trip each one and finish with follow-up

atoms.text: get behind the fallen log with Borin, make it our line
call the Black wolf in, let him charge the log
trip Black wolf as he charges over the log
he's prone on the log — Pip, strike now
hold the line, Borin — next one won't get through

plans.goal: Lure wolves into pincer attack with Borin, trip on one side while he hits from other
steps: Split the pack by moving unpredictably
Get one wolf between me and Borin

atoms.strategy: Separate one wolf from the pack
atoms.text: dart away from the group, isolate Old wolf
lead Old wolf between me and Borin
trip Old wolf and Borin closes in — we have him
I'll trip Lean wolf next — Borin, be ready on the right side
rotate left, hunt the Grey wolf

plans.goal: Use deadfall trap strategically to disable wolves, collapse quickly on trapped target
steps: Spring the deadfall when wolf is in kill zone
Follow up with maximum focus fire
Use the confusion to press other wolves

atoms.text: get to the deadfall at the post, wait for the pack to commit
spring the deadfall when Black wolf crosses the post
deadfall's down — everyone, pile on Black wolf now
trip Grey wolf while the others press the first
don't let them regroup, keep them falling one by one
